judgement.reason: Mastodon needs a separate Node.js streaming server alongside the Rails web server for its real-time UI, and Deployz runs only one web service.

evidence.quote: **Real-time, chronological timeline updates** - updates of people you're following appear in real-time in the UI.

reviews.findingEvidence: Unsupported architecture: docker-compose.yml defines 2 application services (web, streaming). Deployz runs ONE web process per deployment plus declared background workers.
reviews.reason: Mastodon's streaming API is a separate Node.js service that serves real-time timelines on its own port, and none of the shown lines prove that production does without it.
